AT THE HANDS OF.Definition: because of what was done by

STRIPPED.Definition: forced to give up something, such as his clothes or his title

ROTTEN.Definition: gone bad and starting to decay

HUNG.Definition: kept off the ground by a rope around his neck

CONSCIOUS.Definition: awake and aware of what was happening

EXECUTIONER’S.Definition: of the person whose job was to kill him as a punishment

POLE.Definition: a long, thin piece of wood or metal

ANCESTORS.Definition: family members who lived long before him

HEIR.Definition: the person who would become ruler after him

CRISIS.Definition: a time of great difficulty or danger

CIVIL WAR.Definition: fighting between groups of people in the same country

SUCCESSION.Definition: choice of who would be the next ruler

POWER-HUNGRY.Definition: always wanting more control over others

NOBILITY.Definition: people of the highest social class, such as lords

HATER.Definition: a person who strongly dislikes someone or something

DARE.Definition: be bold or rude enough to (said when angry about it)

SLAUGHTERED.Definition: killed cruelly and in large numbers

MILITIA.Definition: a group of ordinary people trained to fight, not professional soldiers

BOG.Definition: an area of soft, very wet ground

MARSHLAND.Definition: a low, flat area of ground that is always wet and soft

ETIQUETTE.Definition: accepted rules about how to behave

SETTLEMENTS.Definition: places where people lived, such as villages and towns

ACCOUNTS.Definition: written or spoken reports of what happened

TYRANT.Definition: a cruel ruler who uses power unfairly

RETREATED.Definition: moved back, away from the enemy

BOW.Definition: a weapon made of a bent piece of wood and a string, used to shoot arrows

ARROWS.Definition: thin, pointed sticks that are shot as weapons

REWARDS.Definition: prizes or payments given in return for help

REWARD.Definition: money offered in return for help

TEMPTING.Definition: attractive and hard to say no to

BETRAYED.Definition: handed over to his enemies by someone who should have been loyal

SHOW TRIAL.Definition: a public court case where the result has already been decided

HIGH TREASON.Definition: the most serious crime against your king or country

NOBLEMAN.Definition: a male member of the highest social class

PSYCHE.Definition: mind; way of thinking and feeling

COWARD.Definition: a person who is not brave
